headline: Planning Board to review site plans, subdivisions, and conditional use permits for several South Willow Street, Pine Street, Union Street, Lake Avenue, and Gold Street properties.
summary: The meeting covers site plan, subdivision, and conditional use permit applications for a charitable gaming facility, a fueling station redevelopment, a mid-rise residential building, two residential conversions, and a dog boarding and daycare facility. The board will also review new applications for regional impact.
items: SP2026-010 – site plan for redevelopment of five lots into one lot for a 73,240 sq. ft. Charitable Gaming Facility with 1,086 parking spaces at 1279 South Willow Street and nearby addresses
CU2026-004 – conditional use permit for reduced parking during phased construction at the same Charitable Gaming Facility site
S2026-011 – subdivision to adjust lot line between 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive, moving 11,683 SF to create a 41,659 SF lot
CU2026-005 – conditional use permit to reduce required parking from 19 to 14 spaces at 1265 South Willow Street
SP2026-011 – site plan to raze and rebuild a fueling station with convenience store, drive-through restaurant, and new fuel canopy at 1265 South Willow Street
CU2026-010 – conditional use permit for reduced parking (172 of 181 required spaces) for a four-story building with 8,290 SF commercial space and 167 dwelling units at 88 Pine Street
SP2026-018 – site plan to convert a three-unit dwelling into a four-unit dwelling at 883 Union Street
SP2026-016 – site plan to convert a two-unit mixed-use building into a six-unit residential building at 308 Lake Avenue
CU2026-008 – conditional use permit for an Animal Boarding and/or Kenneling Facility at 800 Gold Street
CU2026-009 – conditional use permit to reduce parking from 19 to 13 spaces for the Animal Boarding facility at 800 Gold Street
SP2026-017 – site plan to redevelop 800 Gold Street into a dog hotel and daycare facility
Review of new applications for Regional Impact and comment by the Manchester Conservation Commission
location: City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza, Manchester, New Hampshire 03101

 MANCHESTER PLANNING BOARD 
BUSINESS MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, October 15, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers 
 
I. The Chair calls the meeting to order and introduces Planning Board members and Planning 
staff. 
 
II. BUSINESS MEETING: 
 
1. SP2026-010 – Phases 2 & 3  
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a new site plan application for 
the redevelopment of five lots (formerly three lots) into a single lot of record for a proposed 73,240 
sq. ft. (formerly 63,175 sq. ft.) Charitable Gaming Facility wit h 1,086 parking spaces (formerly 
562) and the associated site improvements, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss & O’Neill, Inc. for 
Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC.  (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance) 
 
2. CU2026-004 – Phases 2 & 3  
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a conditional use permit is for a 
reduction in required parking due t o the phasing of construction. The applicant seeks to keep the 
existing facility until the new facility is granted occupancy, at such time the existing facility is to be 
razed and the rema inder of the parking field would be completed, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss 
& O’Neill, Inc. for Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC . (Reviewed under Current Zoning 
Ordinance) 
 
3. S2026-011  
Properties located at 1265 Sou th Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, 
Lots 6 and 7B) , a subdivision application t o adjust the abutting lot lines located between Lots 6 
and 7B, where Lot 7B is to allocate 11,683 SF in area to Lot 6, resulting in a new total lot area of 
41,659 SF for Lot 6, in a BC-2 Zoning District. Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Aranosian Oil Company, 
Inc. and Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)  
 
4. CU2026-005

application to reduce on-site parking from the 19 spaces as required to 14 spaces provided, in a BC-
2 Zoning District. Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Aranosian Oil Company, Inc. (Reviewed under 
Current Zoning Ordinance)

5. SP2026-011

6. CU2026-010

that will result in the construction of a four-story mid-rise building with approximately 8,290 SF of 
ground-floor commercial space and 167 dwelling units, where 181 parking s paces are required and 
172 parking spaces are proposed, located in the DT -1 Zoning District. Joseph M. Wichert, L.L.S., 
Inc., for Valley Pine Corporation (Owner), and Commonwealth Collective, LLC. 
 
7. SP2026-018 
Property located at  883 Union Street (Tax M ap 53, Lot 5 ), a site plan application for the 
conversion of an existing three -unit reside ntial dwelling into a four -unit r esidential dwelling,

8. SP2026-016  
Property located at 308 Lake Avenue (Tax Map 56, Lot 31) , a site plan application for the 
conversion of an existing mixed -use building with two residential dwelling units  into a residential 
multi-family building with six residential units and all associated improve ments, located in an MX-
2 Zoning District. Keach-Nordstrom Associates, Inc. for Three NH Guys, LLC 
 
9. CU2026-008 
Property located at  800 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 5) , a conditional use permit application

10. CU2026-009 
Property located at  800 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 5) , a conditional use permit application 
for a reduction in onsite p arking where 19 parking spaces are required and 13 parking spaces are

Downtown Dog Lodge, LLC, for Oren H. and Beverly M. Stevens Revocable Trust. 
 
11. SP2026-017 
Property located at 800 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 5), a site plan application to redevelop the

services: overnight boarding, dog daycare/play, and dog training, located in a BC -2 Zoning 
District.  Downtown Dog Lodge, LLC, for Oren H. and Beverly M. Stevens Revocable Trust.
